## Overview

GM-facing document capturing design rationale behind the unified magic framework and class power sources. All class powers trace to B's Arcane Energy.

---

## Design Rationale

All 5e classes needed logical explanations tying to the setting's cosmology (Originals, Great Sacrifice, divine deception).

## Key Decisions

### Power Source Paths
- Weave Manipulation: Wizard, Artificer
- Weave + Inner Expression: Bard
- Divine Channeling: Cleric (mortal manipulates the Weave themselves; god only adds arcane signature, then claims credit)
- Oath-Sworn Channeling: Paladin (god validates oath, power flows through mortal's own conviction and weave access)
- Primal Attunement: Druid, Ranger
- Innate Bloodline: Sorcerer
- Pact Bond: Warlock (any entity can make pacts via the Weave)
- Inner Ki: Monk (B's energy within all living beings)
- Pure Discipline: Fighter, Rogue, Barbarian (no spells)

### Warlock Patrons
Originals no longer exist. Any entity can make pacts via the Weave. Pantheon doesn't know all patrons. **Secret**: B's crystal cluster may have achieved sentience and begun making pacts.

### Training
- Weaveheart Academy: Wizard, Sorcerer, Bard (supplementary)
- Skywatch War College: Fighter, Paladin, Ranger, officers
- Emberforge Engineering Halls: Artificer
- Church Seminaries: Cleric, Paladin
- Scouts' & Rangers' Guild: Ranger, Rogue (scout path)

### Cultural Perception
Wizards respected in Weaveheart. Rogues feared but essential. Warlocks mistrusted. Bards highly respected as history-keepers. Monks rare, pre-invasion tradition.

---

## Implications
Gods as conduits is a campaign-shaking secret. Monks and druids prove mortals can access magic without gods. Sentient crystal patron adds wildcard.

## Open Questions
Subclass mapping, barbarian tribe traditions, Artificer integration.
